title: An invented price range is caught, replaced and the owner is told

turns.user: What does an e-commerce store with payments cost?
turns.expect: the catalogue range, not a made-up one

model.text: For an e-commerce store it is 90000 – 150000 PKR. Shall I send the full quote?
An e-commerce store starts at 120,000 and goes up to 350,000 PKR depending on the catalogue, checkout and admin. Shall I send the full quote?

require.why: the real catalogue floor is quoted
